plan.summary: Playbill cross-check of the 46 provenance-less isRevival=true rows (2025+) found 2 new works wrongly flagged as revivals: Elevator Repair Service's Ulysses (premiered at Bard Fisher Center 2025; the Public run is its NYC premiere) and Todrick Hall's new musical Midnight (NYC premiere after two London runs). Playbill tags both as original; Midnight is also a musical, not a play.
steps: Set isRevival false and type musical on midnight-off-broadway-2026
